---
title: "A week of Larkhaven Bikes"
subtitle: "2 to 8 June 2025"
format: revealjs
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
week <- read_csv("data/trips-week.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## The week in one number

**`r format(nrow(week), big.mark = ",")`** complete trips, from `r n_distinct(week$start_station)` stations.

## When people ride

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
week |>
  count(hour = hour(started_at), member_type) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = n, colour = member_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Hour of the day", y = "Trips", colour = NULL)
```

## Who rides

- Members: `r sum(week$member_type == "member")` trips
- Casual riders: `r sum(week$member_type == "casual")` trips
